_about: Reader-facing factions. Claude-owned. Descriptions must be supported by saga/chronicle/. device: lance|bell|censer|crown|redhand|knee; numeral only for lances. Optional picture (only for a faction already on the page): image (a path under saga/art/, e.g. factions/<id>.jpg), image_alt (what it shows, for screen readers), image_caption, and image_focus ("50% 50%": the centre of the 16:9 crop); the site shows it in the codex entry, tap to enlarge. Optional aliases: other words the Chronicle uses for the faction ("Confessors", "the Ninth"); the first mention in a scene links to its Codex entry with a preview.

factions.name: The Ninth Lance
factions.description: Darrow's company: sixty knights and sixty squires on the west bank of Harrow Ford. Nineteen came home. He knows the other forty-one names and does not say them.

factions.name: The Sixth Lance
factions.description: Hollis Garrow's company, ordered with the Ninth to clear the ford.

factions.name: The Second Lance
factions.description: Aldric Vane's company, held in reserve. When the Grace failed it sat its horses on the west bank in perfect order, untouched, and watched.

factions.name: The Crown
factions.description: The power whose Oathstones fill a kneeling knight with the Grace, and whose heralds proclaim that the Grace left the knights of Harrow Ford for the faithlessness of their oaths.

factions.name: The Confessors
factions.description: Grey cloaks who climb mountains for names, not for the Hollowed or the dying. Six of them ride the Holloway with a cart and a censer smoking in the snow, carrying a list of the Faithless at Saint Ysolde's that was read aloud at the inn in Coldmere: the ones they have come to bring down to kneel. Hollis's name is second. Asked who was first, Wren only looked at Darrow.
factions.image_alt: Through a brass spyglass: six riders in hooded grey cloaks, their faces hidden, ride single file along a snowy road under a cliff, one swinging a smoking censer on a chain, with a covered cart drawn by a mule behind them.
factions.image_caption: Through Sister Pell's glass: six grey cloaks, a cart and a censer on the Holloway.

factions.name: The House of Menders
factions.description: The House above the Thousand Steps that takes the ones the lowland surgeons cannot fix and do not want to watch. Mender Vorne did the Binding there with an art the Crown burned people for, three hundred years ago.

factions.name: The Faithless
factions.description: What the heralds call the knights who came back from Harrow Ford, to be received with mercy at the Oathspire and permitted to kneel anew. Hollis's answer, on the cart: kneel to that.

factions.name: The clans of the Thornwild
factions.description: Fighters with long knives and boar spears, drawn up at the ford in a ragged screen in front of carts, old people, children and a goat, and looking behind them into the trees.
